integrity: The theorem is justified by an analytic entropy-envelope and saddle-point proof. Reproducible numerical checks test finite parameters, not infinite assertions. Historical priority remains provisional and independent review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic strong-marker-penalty regime and the single marker-cylinder observable only; finite-parameter optimizing density need not be unique; no uniform explicit remainder constant or general all-Hölder-observable bound.
title: Three-scale optimal free-energy stability in the square-gap shift
